invariants: every sample.metrics key and summary.metrics key exists in metricDefinitions
every metricDefinitions key appears in every sample.metrics object and in summary.metrics
number, integer, and boolean metric values match the declared valueType in every sample and summary
each summary statistic is recomputed from the corresponding samples, except exact Boolean metrics which require identical sample values
p50, p95, and p99 sort finite sample values ascending and use nearest-rank index max(0, ceil(percentile * sampleCount) - 1) without interpolation
mean uses an IEEE-754 binary64 sum divided by sampleCount; validation accepts absolute error at most 1e-9 or relative error at most 1e-9 and applies no prior rounding
min, max, and sum use the exact finite sample values; integer sums reject overflow beyond the JavaScript safe-integer range
exact requires every sample value to be identical and the summary value to equal it
core summary values are recomputed from samples using method.statistic
check names are unique and every required suite check is present
check:contracts rejects structural or recomputation drift; check:release-candidate additionally requires every release-gating check to pass
